name: Celise
source:
Celise serves Queen Marcia as a researcher and archivist, delving into the ancient mysteries of the arcane arts.

Hailing from the renowned human Accademy of Magic at Vicarus, she as a human, is gradually adapting to the refined ways of elven life.

[In game description]
